question:
**Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.**

The story shows the importance of __self-esteem__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Pride**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Self-esteem**" refers to one's confidence and sense of self-worth. (आत्म सम्मान)

 
 
• **For example- ***You sound like you need to build up your confidence and self-esteem.*
 
 
 
• Marked option "**Pride**" also means a feeling of satisfaction or accomplishment in oneself. (स्वयं में उपलब्धि)
 
 
• **For example- ***They can look back on their endeavours with pride.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the story highlights the importance of having a positive self-image.
 
• So, it is clear that the appropriate synonym for "**self-esteem**" is "**pride**".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Let us look at the meaning of the other options.

 
• **Humility **means being humble or modest, which is the opposite of self-esteem. (विनम्रता)
 
• **Disgrace **means shame or dishonour, which is not related to the concept of self-esteem. (शर्म या अपमान)
 
• **Shyness **means being timid or nervous, which is also not related to self-esteem. (डरपोक या घबराया हुआ)
